blocks.en: The following lemma is a direct consequence of the definitions.
blocks.zh: 以下引理是定义的直接推论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is self-adjoint if and only if it is symmetric and $\mathcal{D}(A)=\mathcal{D}(A^*)$.
blocks.zh: 算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是自伴随的, 当且仅当它是对称的且 $\mathcal{D}(A)=\mathcal{D}(A^*)$.
blocks.label: lem:self-adjoint-symmetric-domain-equality

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For a bounded operator, symmetry and self-adjointness are the same thing.
blocks.zh: 对于有界算子, 对称性与自伴随性是一回事.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ is self-adjoint if and only if it is symmetric.
blocks.zh: 算子 $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ 是自伴随的, 当且仅当它是对称的.
blocks.label: thm:bounded-symmetric-operator-self-adjoint

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: By definition self-adjointness implies symmetry. Furthermore, if $\mathcal{D}(A)=H$ and $A$ is symmetric, then by \eqref{eq:symmetric-operator-pairing-identity}, $\mathcal{D}(A^*)=\mathcal{D}(A)=H$.
blocks.zh: 由定义, 自伴随性蕴含对称性. 此外, 若 $\mathcal{D}(A)=H$ 且 $A$ 是对称的, 则由 \eqref{eq:symmetric-operator-pairing-identity} 得 $\mathcal{D}(A^*)=\mathcal{D}(A)=H$.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As we shall see in Problem~\ref{ex:second-derivative-symmetric-not-self-adjoint}, there are examples of unbounded symmetric operators that are not self-adjoint.
blocks.zh: 正如在 Problem~\ref{ex:second-derivative-symmetric-not-self-adjoint} 中将看到的, 存在并非自伴随的无界对称算子.

blocks.en: For a more general partial differential operator, such as those defined in Example~\ref{ex:differential-operator-boundary-domains}, calculation of the adjoint is complicated by the fact that we cannot yet calculate the closure of the operator. However, without closing the operator, one can show that the Hilbert adjoint is an \emph{extension} of the formal adjoint defined in Definition~\ref{lem:distribution-convolution-continuity}.
blocks.zh: 对于更一般的偏微分算子, 例如 Example~\ref{ex:differential-operator-boundary-domains} 中定义的算子, 由于目前还无法计算算子的闭包, 伴随的计算变得复杂. 然而, 无需先使算子闭合, 就能证明 Hilbert 伴随是 Definition~\ref{lem:distribution-convolution-continuity} 中定义的形式伴随的\emph{扩张}.
blocks.label: ex:general-differential-hilbert-formal-adjoint

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As we shall see below, self-adjoint operators have many properties that are useful in application. However, as the example above indicates, it is often difficult to determine whether an unbounded operator is self-adjoint. (We must first close the operator, and as we have seen, finding the domain of the closure is often nontrivial.) Fortunately, we can define a related property called \emph{essential self-adjointness} for which there is a relatively easy test.
blocks.zh: 正如下文将看到的, 自伴随算子具有许多在应用中有用的性质. 然而, 正如上述例子所表明的, 判断无界算子是否自伴随往往很困难. (必须先使算子闭合, 而且如前所见, 求闭包的定义域往往并非易事.) 幸运的是, 可以定义一种称为\emph{本质自伴随性}的相关性质, 它有相对容易的判别方法.
